units.source_text: 髭黑大将穿着柔软而称体的衣服，仪态虽然比不上盖世无双的美男子源氏，但也秀丽堂皇，非常人可比，令人看了肃然起敬。

en.t: General Higekuro was dressed in soft, well-fitting robes. Though his bearing could not compare with Genji, the peerless handsome man of the age, he too was splendid and dignified, far beyond ordinary people, and inspired solemn respect in those who saw him.

units.source_text: 随从人等在外面叫喊：“雪渐渐停止了。

en.t: The attendants outside called out, "The snow is gradually stopping.
It must be late in the night by now, mustn't it?"

units.source_text: 他们不敢正式催促，装作伙伴闲谈，又咳嗽几声。

en.t: They did not dare urge him openly, so they pretended to be chatting among themselves and coughed a few times.

units.source_text: 中将君和木工君等都悲叹：“做人真没意思啊！”

en.t: Lady Chujo, Lady Moku, and the others all lamented, "How pointless it is to be human!"

units.source_text: 她们躺在那里，相与共话。

en.t: They lay there talking with one another.

units.source_text: 夫人正在沉思冥想，姿态优雅地躺卧着。

en.t: The lady lay in an elegant posture, sunk in deep thought.

units.source_text: 忽然站起身来，将大熏笼下面的香炉取出，走到髭黑大将后面，一下子把一炉香灰倒到他头上。

en.t: Suddenly she rose, took the incense burner from beneath the large perfume brazier, went behind General Higekuro, and in one motion poured a whole burnerful of incense ash over his head.

units.source_text: 咄嗟之间的事，谁都不曾提防。

en.t: It happened in an instant, and no one had been on guard.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将大吃一惊，一时呆若木鸡。

en.t: General Higekuro was so startled that for a moment he stood frozen like a wooden doll.

units.source_text: 极细的香灰侵入眼睛里和鼻孔里，弄得他昏头塌脑，看不清四周情状。

en.t: The extremely fine incense ash got into his eyes and nostrils, leaving him dizzy and muddled, unable to see what was happening around him.

units.source_text: 他两手乱挥，想把香灰掸去，然而浑身是灰，掸不胜掸，只得把衣服脱下。

en.t: He flailed both hands, trying to brush off the ash, but his whole body was covered with it and there was too much to sweep away, so he had no choice but to take off his robes.

units.source_text: 倘使神经正常，而做此种行为，那是无礼之极，此人没有再顾的价值了。

en.t: If she had been in her right mind and had done such a thing, it would have been the height of rudeness, and she would no longer have been worth any consideration.

units.source_text: 然而这是鬼魂附体，使她被丈夫厌弃。

en.t: But this was because a spirit had possessed her, causing her husband to turn against her.

units.source_text: 因此身边的侍女们都同情她。

en.t: For that reason, the ladies-in-waiting around her all felt sympathy for her.

units.source_text: 她们呼号奔走，忙着替主人换衣服。

en.t: They cried out and hurried about, busy changing their master's clothes.

units.source_text: 然而许多香灰钻进鬓发里，又沾遍了全身。

en.t: Even so, a great deal of incense ash had worked its way into his side locks and was smeared all over his body.

units.source_text: 似这般模样，如何走进玉鬘的洞房清宫中去呢！

en.t: Looking like this, how could he possibly enter Tamakazura's pure bridal chamber?
